title: With no prior game dev experience, I built this 3D martial arts demo in 3 months using AI.
author: Chengzhong_PR
selftext:
I have been building my first game project called Adaptive Zero for 3 months, and I’ve got a free demo out now.

Try the free Windows demo on itch.io: \[https://pr-zeus.itch.io/adaptive-zero\](https://pr-zeus.itch.io/adaptive-zero)

If you are interested, please give the demo a try and let me know what you like and dislike. Thanks!

I use AI throughout development, including code, enemy models, animation, cinematics and audio. The gameplay footage uses an automated test pilot with preset waves; Athena (protagonist) takes hits but can’t die during recording.
